prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact Layout Adoption Certificate Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate step using a compact layout with an official adoption badge and pet summary preview. (why: Adoption has high drop-off duration (median 89s, mean 1017s) and support emails report custom pet issues. Redesigning adoption screens proved effective (+1.6% avg win) in past tests.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Status Progress Wait Info: Display explicit progress details and estimated completion time on the waiting screen while desktop render engine initializes. (why: The waiting step (home target) takes median 201s / mean 2336s and past lessons show wait_info changes consistently win (+1.5% avg). Support also reported pets not opening.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Pet Persistence & Account Protection Copy: Update sign-in headline and body to emphasize protecting pet data and preventing pet loss across restarts. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing/reset after signing in. Copy changes on sign_in have the highest win rate (5 out of 11 tests).)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Creation Diagnostic Diagnostic Flow: Insert a diagnostic recovery sub-flow inside pet upload/creation to automatically detect photo errors and offer quick fixes. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or wrong-looking pets. A diagnostic flow during creation prevents drop-off.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Safeguard & Multi-Device Sync Copy: Add reassurance copy under sign-in options explaining how signing in syncs pet state and prevents account duplication. (why: Support mailbox received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after re-login. Copy changes on sign_in are high-performing.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Engine Launch Wait Info: Provide detailed notification text and background load progress steps on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s. Giving clear loading status reduces drop-off during long engine load times.)

scores.note: Adoption redesign has solid track record (+1.6% avg across 9 tests). High duration and support reports provide strong evidence.
Home wait_info is a proven winning category (+1.5% avg). Addresses extremely high wait times and reported bugs.
Sign-in copy changes consistently win (+1.6% avg over 11 tests). High evidence from 8 support emails, copy-only implementation.
New sub-flow has high cost (needs new screens). Past new_flow sample size is small (1 test), leading to lower confidence despite high lift potential.
Sign-in copy updates are low cost and high confidence (+1.6% avg), directly addressing 8 user support emails.
Wait_info on home step aligns with proven performance (+1.5% avg). Directly targets long engine initialization times.
